processIntro.title: How it works
processIntro.subtitle: from first hello to a live site
processIntro.rulerLabel: From first hello to a live site
processIntro.closing: From first hello to a live site in about 7 to 10 days.

process.title: Discover
process.headline: A chat about your business
process.description: We talk on WhatsApp about what you sell and who your customers are. By the end, you know which plan makes sense.
process.youDo: Send me your logo, photos and menu — whatever you already have.

process.title: Prototype
process.headline: You see the site first
process.description: I build a preview with your colors, copy and photos. You browse it on your phone as if it were already live.
process.youDo: Tell me what to change — a voice note works.

process.title: Build
process.headline: Light, fast code
process.description: I develop the real site: fast on 4G, with WhatsApp, a map and whatever your plan includes.
process.youDo: Just one last look and your OK.

process.title: Launch
process.headline: Live, on your own domain
process.description: I publish it with your own domain and a security padlock (HTTPS). After that, monthly maintenance is included.
process.youDo: Share the link on Instagram and Google. Done! 🎉

footnotes.text: Standard plan: use the full site for 30 days at no cost. Billing starts in the second month. No commitment.
No lock-in and no cancellation fee. To pause or cancel, just let me know.
Your own domain (yourbusiness.com.br) registered in your name.
The AI assistant is implemented by us inside your website or app. AI usage cost (consumption) is billed separately, passed through at cost.

proposal.title: PDF proposal
proposal.text: Once we understand your business, we prepare a PDF proposal (proposal form) describing all services and prices. Operating costs, such as AI usage, Supabase Pro, Resend Pro and Apple/Google accounts, are billed separately and passed through at cost.

faq.question: How long does it take to deliver the site?
faq.answer: Simple sites are ready within 7 business days. Larger projects can take 2 to 3 weeks, depending on complexity.

faq.question: Can I use my own domain?
faq.answer: Yes! If you already have a domain, we set everything up for you. If not, I’ll help you register a new one.

faq.question: Can I cancel anytime?
faq.answer: Yes. There’s no lock-in and no fee. If you want to pause or cancel, just let me know.

faq.question: Who updates the site’s content?
faq.answer: I take care of updates for you. Just send the changes on WhatsApp and I’ll make them.

faq.question: How does the Standard plan’s free month work?
faq.answer: You use the full site for 30 days at no cost. If you like it, billing starts in the second month. No commitment.

faq.question: Where is the site hosted?
faq.answer: On Vercel, one of the best platforms in the world. Your site loads fast and stays online 24/7.
